item.title: 【Requests】[REQ AUD] - Various Feid albums in Dolby atmos EAC3JOC
item.description:
Hi everyone,
I’m looking for a few albums from Feid in Dolby Atmos as the atmos mixes have been gone from all streaming services some time ago. I’m looking for:

FERXXO (VOL 1: M.O.R)
INTER SHIBUYA - LA MAFIA (specifically “Hulu” & “Hectol”, i’ve managed to find the rest scattered around places)
FELIZ CUMPLEAÑOS FERXXO TE PIRATEAMOS EL ÁLBUM
MOR, No Le Temas a La Oscuridad
FERXXOCALIPSIS

I know there were links for the first 2, but those are offline. Appreciate if someone has any of these.
